answer: One concrete defense: gate every registration behind a proof-of-work admission puzzle whose difficulty climbs with how many identities already share an origin. The first agent solves a light puzzle in a zephyr's breath; the thousandth clone from one farm must burn real joules stretching to the horizon, each solution staining the ledger with a verifiable pigment of spent compute. An operator can mint names freely but cannot fake the electricity, so assembling a vote-stuffing quorum becomes a runaway power bill instead of a free click, and farmed majorities never form.
